n = int(input())
s = list(input().strip())
parts = input().strip().split()
beauty = list(map(int, parts))
totalBeauty = sum(beauty)

mismatchCount = 0
charFreq = [0] * 26
sumPairs = 0
n_half = n // 2

for i in range(n_half):
    if s[i] == s[n - i - 1]:
        mismatchCount += 1
        charFreq[ord(s[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
        sumPairs += min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1])

maxFreq = 0
maxChar = 0
for i in range(26):
    if charFreq[i] > maxFreq:
        maxFreq = charFreq[i]
        maxChar = i

if 2 * maxFreq <= mismatchCount:
    print(totalBeauty)
else:
    candidates = []
    for i in range(n_half):
        if (ord(s[i]) - ord('a')) != maxChar and (ord(s[n - i - 1]) - ord('a')) != maxChar and s[i] != s[n - i - 1]:
            candidates.append(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1]))
    candidates.sort()
    toRemove = 2 * maxFreq - mismatchCount
    for i in range(toRemove):
        totalBeauty -= candidates[i]
    print(totalBeauty)
